title: Empaquetar preflight estático V18 antes del browser residual
mission: Build a repository-grounded static preflight evidence pack for Facultad V18 Notas/login/schedule before any representative-browser rerun. Verify pinned source bytes and deterministic non-runtime invariants already encoded in the regression harness, then state exactly which residuals still require JavaScript desktop/mobile execution. This must reduce browser-worker waste without pretending static evidence is browser evidence.
definition_of_done: Record exact current blob/source identities for the V18 study surface and pinned regression harness inputs.

Verify deterministic static invariants for native notes/date bridge, absence of synthetic Clase 01–04 / Fecha por definir placeholders, capability-honest disabled generic login, native schedule bridge markers and Version anterior fallback.
Reconcile the existing notes/date and login VERIFIED/DONE returns with the current pinned regression contract.
Produce one bounded residual list containing only checks that genuinely require a representative JavaScript browser.
Do not infer runtime PASS, Human Accepted, Current or Served from static evidence.
